mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the need for wisdom and adequate preparation for the coming of the Lord Jesus Christ to establish His Kingdom."
The overall lesson is the need for wisdom and adequate preparation for the coming of the Lord Jesus Christ to establish His Kingdom.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Christological center of Luther, the founder of the German Reformation."
A new element on Reformation interpretation is the Christological center of Luther, the founder of the German Reformation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of types in the Bible."
Typology is the study of types in the Bible.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to be called "lower Criticism" and the aim is to construct a text as close to the original text written by its author (i.e. autograph) as possible."
Textual criticism is used to be called "lower Criticism" and the aim is to construct a text as close to the original text written by its author (i.e. autograph) as possible.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is regarded as one of the formative theologians of the New Testament."
John is regarded as one of the formative theologians of the New Testament.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are made up of two important components: One, the sayings and teachings of Jesus; Two, the story of the life and ministry of Jesus."
The gospels are made up of two important components: One, the sayings and teachings of Jesus; Two, the story of the life and ministry of Jesus.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a special form of criticism that is characteristic of the new Hermeneutic."
Content Criticism is a special form of criticism that is characteristic of the new Hermeneutic.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only bridge between the Gospels and the Epistles."
Acts is the only bridge between the Gospels and the Epistles.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Gospel of Christ as the King."
Matthew is the Gospel of Christ as the King.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an academic and spiritual exercise."
The study of Biblical hermeneutics is an academic and spiritual exercise.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called the Lion of Judah (Rev. 5:5)."
Jesus Christ is called the Lion of Judah (Rev. 5:5).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an historical faith based on certain concrete historical events in human experience."
Christianity is an historical faith based on certain concrete historical events in human experience.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an extension of redaction criticism."
Canon criticism is an extension of redaction criticism.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the brief figures of speech that are important in Biblical interpretation."
Similes and metaphors are the brief figures of speech that are important in Biblical interpretation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the separation in time between the author and the reader."
Historical gap is the separation in time between the author and the reader.
